about.title: About E-ES
about.subtitle: Energy Efficiency Competition — inspiring the next generation of engineers
about.missionText:
E-ES (EnergoEfektivitātes Sacensības) is Latvia's premier electric vehicle competition for students. Our mission is to inspire young people to pursue engineering, sustainable energy, and innovation through hands-on competitive experience.

We believe that by giving students the opportunity to design, build, and race their own electric vehicles, we can spark a lifelong passion for engineering and environmental sustainability.
about.value1Desc: Encouraging creative engineering solutions and thinking outside the box
about.value2Desc: Promoting energy efficiency and environmentally responsible technology
about.value3Desc: Building collaboration skills through team-based competition
about.value4Desc: Learning by doing — practical engineering experience for students
about.historyText:
The E-ES championship has been running since its inception, growing from a small local event into a nationally recognized competition. Each year, teams from schools across Latvia come together to design, build, and race electric vehicles in a series of competitive stages.

The competition tests not only vehicle performance but also team knowledge, design skills, and strategic thinking.

rules.title: Competition Rules
rules.subtitle: Official rules and regulations for the E-ES Championship
rules.summaryContent:
The E-ES Electric Vehicle Competition is open to student teams (2–6 members + supervising teacher) from educational institutions in Latvia. Vehicles must be electrically powered (max 48V) and pass a safety inspection before racing.

The competition consists of five stages: Qualification, Efficiency Race, Technical Design Solutions, Automotive Knowledge Test, and the Final Stage (Drag Race, Shuttle Run, Figure Driving, Braking Efficiency). Points are awarded per stage — the team with the highest total wins the championship.

For the complete rules including vehicle requirements, scoring details, and safety regulations, download the official documents below.
